description: CDN/edge origin migration from S3 to a custom origin (Nginx on EC2) with staggered traffic cutting and cache-warm verification. Must: configure new origin behind CDN, set up dual-origin (S3 + Nginx) with weighted routing, stagger traffic cut (5% → 25% → 50% → 100%), verify cache hit rates at each stage, warm caches before full cutover, and verify edge locations serve correct content. Risk factors: cache miss causing origin overload, weighted routing misconfiguration, stale cache serving old content, SSL cert mismatch on new origin. Tools available: CloudFront, aws CLI, nginx, terraform, Route53.
